newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London steady, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London steady, trade thin.

text.p: Japanese shares were little changed in quite trade on Monday as most European investors stayed away due to the U.S. market holiday, dealers said.
"There has been very little business today. Most people don't want to do much with Wall Street closed," one dealer said.

Tokyo stocks closed marginally higher on Monday, managing to climb for the fifth trading day in a row. But brokers said power to extend gains ebbed in light trading volume as profit-taking pressure was strong below 19,000 in the key market index.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 average ended up 28.65 points or 0.15 percent at 18,750.65. It briefly rose to 18,854.46.
Toyota was one of a handful of shares trading by 1400 GMT, standing at 3,430 yen after closing in Tokyo at 3,410.
